name: Forged Portrait Patch
description: A section of the restored portrait that, under close light, is clearly a modern forgery layered over the original canvas.

name: Edmund's Confrontation Note
description: A note in Edmund's own hand, found in the library, reading 'Vale -- explain the portrait tonight, or I call the appraiser myself.'

name: Missing Twenty Minutes
description: A guest's photograph timestamp placing Adrian absent from the ballroom during the exact window Edmund died.

name: Solvent Smell
description: A faint trace of restoration solvent on the library door handle, matching Adrian's restoration kit exactly.

name: Reeve's Private File
description: Investigator Reeve's file on Adrian's past forgery allegations at two other estates, compiled before tonight.

name: Unlatched Side Door
description: A side door near the hidden corridor left unlatched, allowing a quiet route between the ballroom and library.
